text:
sam: FYI - after the qbringup yesterday we're seeing a mismatch between the curation instrumentation and the labeller assignment layer. some samples are stuck in 'pending' but show as assigned in the labeler UI.

tara: ugh. which seedbank? production or canary?

sam: canary seedbank only (q4b-longctx-canary pool). happens when a sample is flagged with 'longform' + dedupe tag. looks like the ingest microtags changed shape so the routing lambda can't match labeler buckets.

miguel: saw a couple of these in my queue. they show duplicate assignments too (two annotators got the same id). could be race on fingerprinting.

anya: is this the thing that caused the golden set re-eval to fail earlier? I saw a spike in disagreement on those long prompts.

sam: yes, the golden holdout had a batch with 12/50 disagreements; digging shows the same sample popped into two different labeler cohorts with different instructions.

label-bot: deploy:ingest-v2 -> completed
label-bot: alert: 6 samples failed routing in last 30m (:warning:)

devon: quick mitigation: can we pause the curation ingestion job and re-run the fingerprint step with v1 hashing for that 6-hour window?

tara: +1 to pause. also we should isolate the quant4b bringup traffic so it doesn't affect reserved queues.

miguel: rehash script I used:

```python tools/rehash_samples.py --seedbank canary --window 1748550000-1748600000 --hash-version v1 --dry-run
```
I can run with --apply if we decide.

anya: if we rehash, we need to regenerate the golden pairing manifest and notify label-ops so they don't relabel stale instructions. I'll draft a quick notice.

sam: plan: pause ingest -> rehash window -> reassign stuck samples to labeler-ops bucket -> run small golden rescore (50 samples) -> unpause. can someone take the rehash work?

miguel: I can run the apply and monitor. will post progress here.

tara: I'll message label-ops and tag @label-ops in the console with the manifest.

devon: logging followup: we should add an instrumentation test in staging that asserts hash shape compatibility after any kernel/quant rollout. I'll open a ticket.

sam: thanks. filing followups: #1 add gating check in onboard playbook, #2 automatic fallback to v1 hash if dedupe mismatch > 1% during bringup, #3 golden-rescore automation for rapid sanity.

label-bot: ticket created: INF-3621 (rehash window), INF-3622 (gating check), INF-3623 (golden rescore job)

sam: i'll kick off the pause now and @miguel pls run the apply when ready. :thumbsup:

miguel: starting apply in 2m, will report back.

devon: +1 on the ticket list, thanks team.

sam: end of thread update: rehash applied, 6 samples reassigned, golden rescore passed (48/50 agreement). reopening ingest with v1 fallback enabled.
